role.title: Intake Officer
permissions: Prepare human assessment requests as local drafts

recipients.title: SYN Bank A / designated human review team
SYN Telco B / designated human intake team

recipientResponsibilities.HANDOVER-BANK: Human verification and assessment of reported unfamiliar debits, credential exposure and transaction information; the prototype only prepares a local draft.
recipientResponsibilities.HANDOVER-TELCO: Human assessment of whether the reported SMS concern falls within the mobile provider remit; do not assume the provider sent the SMS or that SIM swapping occurred. Local draft only; sharing permission unverified.

facts.value:
I received a text message at 09:00 on 16 October 2026 claiming to be SYN Bank A and saying that my account needed verification.

I opened the link at verify-bank.example and entered my online banking password and a one-time code.

At 09:30 I noticed an unfamiliar AUD 2,000 debit in my SYN Bank A app; I do not know whether it is pending or completed.

I use SYN Telco B for my mobile service, and I have not contacted either organisation about this yet.

I have the text message on my phone, but I have not provided any material to the employee.
Claims to be SYN Bank A
Opened the link and entered banking password and one-time code categories; no secret values recorded.
Reported available on phone; not provided or verified

reasons: CONTACT-01: reported bank impersonation SMS; EVENT-01: reported credential entry.
alternatives: Sender identity and the debit's connection to the SMS are unverified.

questions.text: Is the debit shown as pending or completed?
questions.reason: Transaction status affects the bank record and human assessment.

questions.text: Has the sender contacted you again?
questions.reason: Establish whether this contact is continuing.

questions.text: Does the bank app identify the recipient of the debit?
questions.reason: The recipient affects the human assessment record and is not provided.
